experiments.purpose: Validate strategies for lazy iterators to satisfy nextSpan: heap buffer for transforming (Map, Filter), forward-to-base for preserving (Drop, Prefix). Inline Optional REFUTED (withUnsafePointer requires Result: Escapable). Applied in lazy pipeline commit 63bc980. All 7 iterator strategies validated at scale (97 tests).

Validate zero-allocation @_rawLayout(like: Element) buffer for generating iterator nextSpan. Confirms Option E from zero-allocation research: SingleElementBuffer with withUnsafePointer + _overrideLifetime pattern.

Test whether regular stored properties (no @_rawLayout) can back Span creation. withUnsafeMutablePointer(to: &_element) gives in-place pointer (CONFIRMED); withUnsafePointer(to: _element) copies (REFUTED). Stored property is simpler and smaller than @_rawLayout.

Validate full ~Copyable & ~Escapable suppression for lazy sequence types (LazyMap, LazyFilter, chaining). Applied in lazy pipeline commit 63bc980. Additional finding: nested types in separate extension files need where Base: ~Copyable & ~Escapable to match conformance extension context.
Validate nextSpan(maximumCount:) as universal iterator primitive across all storage types

Measure nextSpan(1) overhead vs direct next(): 11 variants. Root cause: Span _unsafeStart init chain (alignment check, mark_dependence, COW). ~Escapable does NOT block SROA. extracting workaround worse. Mitigated: conformers override next() until Span init improves upstream.
Find Property.View patterns compatible with consuming makeIterator for ~Copyable bases. Applied in lazy pipeline commit 63bc980: Property.View narrowed to Copyable bases only.
Verify Sequence.Protocol and Property.View forEach extensions with ~Copyable containers
